_schema._description: Character cards. Unlocked when student meets character in story (see scenes.json 'chars' field).

_fields.name: Display name
_fields.title: Latin title (e.g. 'Rex Thebarum')
_fields.color: Theme color: purple | pink | blue | amber | teal | coral
_fields.stats: Object with sapientia, fortitudo, superbia, fatum (1-10 each)

_statKeys.fatum: fate (how heavily fate weighs on them)

oedipus.name: Oedipus
oedipus.title: Rex Thebarum
oedipus.bio: iuvenis ex Corintho. rex Thebarum. Sphingem solvit.
oedipus.bioEn: A young man from Corinth. King of Thebes. He solved the Sphinx's riddle.

iocasta.name: Iocasta
iocasta.title: Regina
iocasta.bio: regina Thebarum. uxor Oedipi. olim uxor Lai.
iocasta.bioEn: Queen of Thebes. Wife of Oedipus. Once the wife of Laius.

creon.name: Creon
creon.title: Frater Reginae
creon.bioEn: Brother of Jocasta. He went to the oracle at Delphi.

tiresias.name: Tiresias
tiresias.title: Vates Caecus
tiresias.bio: vates. caecus est sed veritatem videt.
tiresias.bioEn: A prophet. He is blind, but he sees the truth.

pastor.name: Pastor
pastor.title: Servus Lai
pastor.bio: pastor antiquus. infantem in monte invenit.
pastor.bioEn: An old shepherd. He found a baby on the mountain long ago.

nuntius.name: Nuntius
nuntius.title: Ex Corintho
nuntius.bioEn: A messenger from Corinth. He carries news.
